set.body:
Intaglio should meet the interaction repertoire documented in the ggiraph book and extend it with typed identity, explicit statistical membership, linked analytical views, consistent SVG/Canvas semantics, accessible controls, and reproducible state.

Requested by the user: "our features should at least be at this level: https://www.ardata.fr/ggiraph-book/ ;; but better designed, more powerful at the end of the day"; subsequently authorized: "turn this into an epic, and lodge in mote".

Design source: docs/design/interaction.md, authored 2026-09-07; inspected implementation SHA 38e8c62b5b3fb74d0a32664a168e95e9f708bd49. The Markdown proposal is currently uncommitted. Its complete text will be preserved in an epic note, SHA-256 510cebe946dec5e92796e413eecb1b63d90a792fad51c78c33f44960749cc570. API/module names remain proposals; registration does not imply implementation or release readiness.

Baseline scope (children 1-8)
- Plain/structured tooltips, direct/nearest hover, configurable placement/style/delay, focus access.
- Hover/selection/focus/inactive styles, inverse emphasis, transitions, and application-controlled styling.
- Typed activation, declarative links, host callbacks, initial/programmatic state, disabled/single/multiple selection, toggle/add/subtract/replace/clear, rectangle and lasso.
- Marks, legend keys, colorbars, facets, axes, titles, labels, annotations; a target/picking capability matrix for every built-in geom and statistic.
- Pan, wheel/pinch/rectangle zoom, bounds/reset, gesture modes, and distinct whole-scene magnification versus data-window navigation preserving trained scales/statistics.
- Linked plots/guides, namespace-safe keys, origin/revision handling, responsive widgets, toolbar, fullscreen, PNG export, standalone HTML, and framework-neutral application integration.
- SVG/Canvas semantic parity, keyboard/touch access, accessible dense-plot navigation, and owned mount/update/subscribe/dispose lifecycles.

Analytical and host extensions (children 9-12)
- Exact aggregate-to-source selection with checked membership/resolver capabilities and selected/total counts.
- Named selection algebra, inspectors, explicit filtering, versioned state, undo/redo, and replay.
- Indexed batch picking, incremental updates, measured performance budgets, and optional JavaFX interaction.

Architectural constraints
Use ordinary plotting objects with optional typed behaviors; separate visual targets, entity keys, and link keys. Preserve compact batch references and explicit retention costs. Keep core portable and free of browser/reactive dependencies. Host effects remain outside deterministic state transitions. A count/representative/incomplete member list is never an exact selected set. Static rendering must remain independently usable.

Completion criteria
1. Every baseline feature category is verified in SVG and Canvas with all built-in target coverage; point-only demos do not establish parity.
2. Two linked scatter plots and a histogram demonstrate hover, keyboard/touch selection, additive/subtractive regions, linked legends, viewport controls, and later exact aggregate member linking.
3. All twelve children close with their stated evidence. The baseline certification child records baseline completion separately from later analytical, performance, and JavaFX delivery.
4. Shared state laws plus independent picking/member oracles cover transforms, clipping, facets, overlapping marks, duplicate labels, repeated values, source revisions, and batch identity.
5. Real browser/native host checks prove interaction/accessibility/lifecycle; existing static conformance and compatibility gates pass. Record exact source/artifact identities and external-consumer evidence.
6. Characterize 10,000-mark SVG and 100,000-point Canvas workloads with hardware/browser, memory, index-build, pointer-to-highlight, and redraw data; establish budgets before making performance claims.

Non-goals and exclusions
No implementation, release, merge, commit, or publication is authorized by this registration task. Do not create a second interactive geom family, embed executable JavaScript strings in the portable plan, silently infer data joins from display labels, rerun statistics as an implicit selection effect, or require an R/Shiny integration for baseline completion. Optional Laminar/notebook adapters may be separate follow-on work. No fixed release date or unmeasured superiority claim.

Reference sources
https://www.ardata.fr/ggiraph-book/intro.html
https://www.ardata.fr/ggiraph-book/customize.html
https://www.ardata.fr/ggiraph-book/shiny.html

Tracking
Child containment uses non-blocking parent relations. Prerequisite dependencies encode execution order. The epic is blocked by all child deliveries and remains open/unassigned; registration must not claim implementation work or reserve source paths.
set.title: [Intaglio][Epic] Deliver ggiraph-baseline interactivity and typed analytical linked views
